detail: Full summary: hook/server version skew flagged by the field is real but currently benign — the sentinel (.last-record) is the only cross-artifact contract (plugin hooks read it, npm server writes it); the new .sessions/ marker was deliberately kept plugin-internal to avoid widening that surface. Any future change to sentinel semantics must consider both artifacts' release cadences.
